mapper.select: SELECT PYMNT_ID , PJ_ID , GRNT_AMT , CNTRCT_AMT , GRNT_PD_DT , CNTRCT_PD_DT , ACCNT_NM , IMP_UID FROM PYMNT_INFO WHERE PJ_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PYMNT_INFO (PYMNT_ID, PJ_ID, GRNT_AMT, CNTRCT_AMT) VALUES ('AL-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('PYMNT_INFO_PK_SEQ')::text, 5, '0'), #{pjId}, #{grntAmt}, #{cntrctAccnt})
mapper.select: SELECT PYMNT_ID, PJ_ID, GRNT_AMT, CNTRCT_AMT, GRNT_PD_DT, CNTRCT_PD_DT, ACCNT_NM, PYMNT_TYP, IMP_UID, DPST_RFND_AMNT, DPST_RFND_DT FROM PYMNT_INFO WHERE PJ_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCNT_HSTRY ( ACCNT_HSTRY_ID , VRTL_ACCNT_ID , AMNT , "TYPE" , ACCNT_INFO , ACCNT_DT , DPSTR , BNK_INFO) VALUES ( 'AH-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('ACCNT_HSTRY_PK_SEQ')::text, 5, '0') , #{vrtlAccntId} , #{amnt} , #{type} , #{accntInfo} , NOW() , #{dpstr} , #{bnkInfo})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PYMNT_INFO PI JOIN PJ_INFO PJI ON PJI.PJ_ID = PI.PJ_ID JOIN MBR_INFO MI ON PJI.ORDR_ID = MI.EMIL_ADDR WHERE MI.CMP_ID = #{cmpId}
